title: Kavi's To-Do app
description: A productivity application developed to simplify daily tasks through a cute and interactive sticky todo interface with persistent storage and reminder features. Designed as a desktop sticky todo application with a cloud-themed UI using Node.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Implements persistent local storage, reminders, due dates, task completion tracking, deletion, and an always-on-top window for quick access.

title: TestLang++ — HTTP API Testing DSL
description: Developed a custom Domain-Specific Language (DSL) for automated HTTP API testing. Implemented a compiler using JFlex and CUP to translate .test files into executable JUnit 5 test classes. Built support for GET/POST/PUT/DELETE requests with response validation, semantic validation (syntax checking, duplicate detection, variable substitution), and a Spring Boot backend simulator for integration testing. Automated compilation and test generation with Maven and Java HttpClient.

title: Strike
description: Group project: Shoe Store e‑commerce system with extensive testing. Implemented PyTest-based unit tests for a FastAPI backend, built and tested JWT authentication endpoints (/auth/register, /auth/login) using httpx.AsyncClient, applied mocking and time-based token expiry tests, and ensured API reliability and security through structured test coverage.

title: BIGO
description: Worked in multiple Agile roles (Business Analyst, QA, DevOps, Developer). Developed an XP reward system and student performance dashboard using React. Performed unit, integration, E2E and API testing; configured CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Slack notifications, and JMeter reporting; managed sprint planning, acceptance criteria, and documentation.

title: Distributed Payment Processing System
description: Team project building a fault-tolerant payment processing system for e-commerce platforms. Implemented consensus (Raft) leader election and transaction replication, vector and Lamport clock synchronization, failover and recovery, and tested reliability using PyTest. Built using Python, gRPC, and distributed systems techniques.

title: Athukorala Traders – Hardware Store Management & E-Commerce System
description: Collaboratively designed the system in Figma and developed a responsive web application for a hardware trading business. Implemented customer-facing features including product browsing, advanced search and filtering, shopping cart management, and purchase order functionality. Developed an administrative dashboard with sales analytics, product management, promotion tracking, activity monitoring, and data visualization features. Enhanced user experience through modern UI/UX design, responsive layouts, interactive components, and optimized performance using React and JavaScript.

title: Archi AI – AI-Powered Architectural Design Platform
description: Collaboratively designed Archi AI in Figma; an application that assists architecture students and professionals in generating architectural design concepts using AI. Contributed to UI/UX design, wireframing, prototyping, and user flow development. Focused on creating a modern, accessible, and user-centered platform that streamlines the architectural design process.

title: Eco Aqua Guardian
description: Eco Aqua Guardian is an eco-friendly water filtration system developed using clay, designed to provide safe and accessible drinking water for rural communities. The system features automated water dispensing, water purity indication, a replaceable filter cartridge for easy maintenance, and a portable tabletop design. It supports both manual water filling and continuous operation through a solenoid valve connection, combining sustainability, functionality, and user-centered design in a practical water purification solution.
technologies: Embedded Systems,Microcontroller,Water Sensors,Solenoid Valve,Mechanical Design,Electronics,Clay Filtration

title: Scoopland — Ice Cream Shop UI/UX Design
description: Scoopland is a modern and interactive mobile application prototype designed in Figma for an online ice cream ordering experience. Users can browse ice cream flavors and products, view item details, select favorites, add products to the cart, and manage orders. The interface emphasizes intuitive navigation, visually appealing layouts, and a user-friendly shopping experience.

title: World of Worlds – 3D Adventure Game (Group Project)
description: Collaborated in developing a 3D game using Unity and Blender. Created and modeled game assets, environments, and objects using Blender. Contributed to game development, scene design, and gameplay implementation in Unity. Worked with team members to build an interactive and engaging gaming experience.
